definitions.explanation: Doing something despite difficulties, risks, or opposition. Implies a conscious choice to proceed anyway.

definitions.gloss: purposely, intentionally (with nuance of going against the norm)
definitions.explanation: Choosing to do something different from what is expected or conventional.

examples.japanese: {敢|あ}えて⟦{言|い}うなら→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: If I had to say, I'm against it.

examples.japanese: {敢|あ}えて⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦することにした→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I decided to take on the challenge anyway.

examples.japanese: {敢|あ}えて⟦{言|い}わせてもらえば→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: If I may be so bold, that's wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていても→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、{敢|あ}えて⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦しかなかった→しかない：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Even though I knew it was dangerous, I had no choice but to press on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦しても→する：00392_suru⟧、{敢|あ}えて⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Even though those around me were opposed, I dared to choose my own path.

examples.japanese: {敢|あ}えて⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦するまでもない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It hardly needs to be said.

examples.japanese: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧、{敢|あ}えて⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわった→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: Even though there were convenient methods, I deliberately stuck to handmade.

examples.japanese: {敢|あ}えて⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}してみた→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I purposely offered a different opinion.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{敢|あ}えて⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: While everyone agreed, I deliberately pointed out the problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ばず→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧、{敢|あ}えて⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}んだ→挑む：12708_idomu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Choosing the hard road rather than the easy one is what made me who I am today.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {敢|あ}えて⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (if I dare say; to put it bluntly)
- {敢|あ}えて～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (dare to do ~)
- {敢|あ}えて～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not bother to ~; not go so far as to ~)

USAGE:
- With affirmative verbs: implies doing something despite obstacles
- With negative verbs: implies not bothering to do something unnecessary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わざわざ→わざわざ：06073_wazawaza⟧ emphasizes going out of one's way or making extra effort
- {敢|あ}えて emphasizes boldness or going against the grain
- ⟦{殊更|ことさら}に→ことさら：noentry⟧ emphasizes deliberate emphasis or exaggeration
